description: ISO 15118-2 EV Charging Traffic Dataset with 734 Labeled Benign and Attack Sessions is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Zeynep Ebru Işık, Erdal Irmak. This dataset contains 734 labeled ISO 15118-2 network traffic sessions generated in a controlled RISE-V2G v1.2.6 testbed with EVCC, SECC, and attacker virtual machines. It covers benign charging communication and six attack classes: replay, connection-oriented denial of service, NDP-based man-in-the-middle, EXI fuzzing, certificate spoofing, and false data injection. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
